idea-plugin.name: Green Claim Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Reads your HTML and Markdown product copy and flags the environmental claims Directive (EU) 2024/825 turns into banned practices on 27 September 2026, with the clause and a compliant rewrite for each hit.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Green Claim Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. Offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/green-claim-lint-empco (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/green-claim-lint-empco

action.text: Green Claim Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Green Claim Lint on the file in the editor
